descriptionChirho: To scatter or plant seed in the ground, used both of literal agricultural sowing and figuratively of sowing the word, sowing to the Spirit or flesh, or sowing in righteousness.
Participial form used substantivally to denote the person who sows, especially 'the sower' in Jesus' parables of the sower.
Passive voice indicating what has been sown or planted, used of seed, the word, or metaphorically of people who receive the sown word, and of the resurrection body that is sown in corruption.
